actual_tool_arguments.prompt:
Use case: identity-preserve. Edit this ENTIRE exact original Silent Storm painted character UV color atlas 1900, Heads\11.testWomen\0.tga, into a faithful four-times finer version. Image1 is the full ACTUAL selected native stored RGB, the edit target. Keep the exact complete square canvas and normalized coordinates of EVERY region, including ALL original light gray unused UV fields and the untouched clipped features at the borders. Output only one flat full texture bitmap.

Preserve the character's original identity, facial proportions, expression, age, skin pigment, hair color/style and softly painted old-game material. The original face is STORED UPSIDE DOWN. KEEP this orientation. Never flip, rotate, crop, rearrange, zoom, center a portrait, repack quadrants, change island sizes, or add margins. Keep all original support color fields and inter-island separation.

Treat the upper-left small eyelash and dental UV region as a painted schematic EXACTLY copied from the reference: preserve EVERY original visible vertical/diagonal thin stroke and dark gap, exact stroke count, length, placement and terminal fades. Preserve EACH existing tooth and tooth separation, mouth stripe width/height/row count and native shape at the original UV positions; do not make a realistic extra set of teeth, regular white dental band, extra glints, changed gum shape or extra eyelashes. Preserve the existing FOUR by FOUR grid of SIXTEEN distinct tiny iris/pupil variants, exactly sixteen at the source UV locations, each source color/shape/reflections intact. Preserve BOTH separate brown hair UV pieces, small upper-left and larger upper-right, their exact silhouettes and textured flow. Preserve every light gray support field and the subtly painted extremely pale upside-down face below. No invented dark void fields or additional hair pieces. Keep the original eye color and facial marks.

Improve only fine resolution of existing softly painted transitions and edges. Retain the original brush softness and matte character surface, broad shading, faint local marks, subtle forehead creases, ears and boundaries. No photorealistic skin pores, wrinkles, hair fibers, new scars, freckles, added dental structure, beard reinterpretation, cosmetics, beautification, sharp contrast, new shine, or extra anatomy. Preserve source shape/count/phase/material/pattern scale and color hierarchy rather than inventing small objects. Whole selected source alpha and brightness are restored programmatically; generate the complete opaque stored RGB canvas without changing layout or painting into original gray support regions.
